additional_info.subject: ID0446869-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / RD 170003110] DC2 Outlet not ready CRM:02699000220
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
For now, I can only say that there is a problem with the Bender:
1: if no new data from IMD recieved within 5s via Modbus
2: connection to PE is corrupt
2: maximum Y-capacity is exceeded at the DC output
0: value not valid (modbus values != relay values)
For this, I would assume that the Modbus connections are not ok. We need to check the following:
Since the error is only for BC2, I would assume this is can only be the root cause. If the problem is not fixed by checking the wiring, please try to swap BC1 and BC2.
If it persists in the BC2 (now in BC1 spot), then please replace it. Don't forget to change the Modbus addresses.
PS: I asked R&D to check why the FW update is not coming online.
I will send this to the RC-AT queue for the site visit.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
